why_best: It visually communicates the transformative impact and density of the incoming intelligence layer without breaking the immersive dashboard environment.
why_bad: A standard lateral wipe or linear fade would reduce a major data shift to routine page navigation, stripping the moment of its executive gravity.
trap: A weak execution will turn the curvature into a cheap, rubbery fisheye glass effect rather than an authoritative, space-bending focal point.
